envelope.description: Companion page shell and runtime loader

body.title: Companion page shell and runtime loader
body.summary: Add src/workflow/artifacts/companion/shell.ts with CompanionPageContent / DescriptionBlock / DescriptionCell types and renderCompanionPage(header, page, runtime): Header (project, title, kind badge, table Work item / Source doc link / Date / User), Narrative (context line + optional narrative), View panel (mermaid or html visual + toolbar + pan/zoom init + fit on load; Mermaid inlined only for mermaid visuals), Description tables (all cells escaped; null -> em dash). A runtime loader reads mermaid.min.js and panzoom.js and throws DiagramGenerationError when either is missing.
acceptanceChecks: Output has Header, Narrative, View, Description in order with the four header-table rows.
Toolbar controls, pan/zoom init and fit-on-load are present for mermaid and html visuals; an html page inlines no Mermaid; no http(s) URL appears.
All table text is escaped and null cells render as an em dash.
A missing runtime asset raises DiagramGenerationError.

tests.name: shell: section order + header table rows + no external URL
shell view panel: toolbar controls, pan/zoom init, fit-on-load for mermaid and html visuals; html page has no Mermaid
shell: escaping of all table text; null cell -> em dash; missing narrative renders only the context line
shell runtime loader: missing asset -> DiagramGenerationError
